text: For 2026-10-19 to 2026-11-15 we project 51 to 65 orders, most likely about 58. This is an estimate from your recent weeks, not a forecast. Demand windows in that period: United States Grand Prix (2026-10-23 to 2026-10-25), Mexico City Grand Prix (2026-10-30 to 2026-11-01), Brazilian Grand Prix (2026-11-06 to 2026-11-08). No single bottleneck limits it right now; keep doing what works.
